entities.name: Methyl quinoline-carboxylate
observations: Reaction input decodes to methyl quinoline-carboxylate, represented as COC(=O)c1ccc2ncccc2c1.
The ester is transformed into the corresponding quinolinylmethanol product.
Source search identified this structure interpretation directly.

entities.name: Quinolinylmethanol
observations: Reaction product decodes to the corresponding hydroxymethyl quinoline, represented as HOCH2c1ccc2ncccc2c1.
The product is consistent with reduction of the methyl ester to a primary alcohol.
Source search identified this structure interpretation directly.

entities.name: Ester-to-primary-alcohol reduction
observations: The net transformation is reduction of a methyl ester to a primary alcohol, not hydrolysis to a carboxylic acid.
Strong matching precedent uses an aluminum hydride reagent consistent with DIBAL-H; another uses an aluminum hydride/lithium system consistent with LiAlH4-type reduction.

entities.name: DIBAL-H ester reduction
observations: Plausible conditions are DIBAL-H in toluene or THF, commonly at low temperature, followed by aqueous workup.
This condition is supported by a directly matching database precedent.

entities.name: LiAlH4 ester reduction
observations: Alternative plausible conditions are LiAlH4 in dry ether or THF, followed by careful aqueous workup.
This condition is supported by a matching aluminum hydride/lithium precedent.
